description: This file implements Webpack's Hot Module Replacement (HMR) runtime logic, managing module updates, dependencies, and hot acceptance rules.

methods.name: createRequire
methods.description: Creates a require function with HMR support, handling module dependencies and chunk loading.

methods.name: createModuleHotObject
methods.description: Creates a hot module object with methods for accepting, declining, disposing, and invalidating modules during HMR.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current HMR status and notifies registered status handlers.

methods.name: trackBlockingPromise
methods.description: Tracks promises that block HMR updates, managing the transition between states.

methods.name: waitForBlockingPromises
methods.description: Waits for all blocking promises to resolve before proceeding.

methods.name: hotCheck
methods.description: Checks for updates and prepares modules for hot replacement.

methods.name: hotApply
methods.description: Applies the hot update to modules if in the correct state.

methods.name: internalApply
methods.description: Performs the actual application of updates, handling dispose, apply, and error states.

methods.name: applyInvalidatedModules
methods.description: Handles modules that have been invalidated and queued for update.
